question: Evaluate: (−9) − (−60) ÷ (−6) + (−3) × 6
solution:
**Given:**

(−9) − (−60) ÷ (−6) + (−3) × 6

**Formula Used:**

Division: a ÷ b

Multiplication: a × b

Subtraction and addition operations

**Calculation:**

⇒ (−9) − (−60) ÷ (−6) + (−3) × 6

⇒ (−9) − 10 + (−3) × 6

⇒ (-9) - 10 + (-18)

⇒ -9 - 10 - 18

⇒ -37

**∴ The correct answer is -37.**
